content.short: Safle is a community-governed Web3 identity and infrastructure tool stack for managing on-chain and off-chain identity across blockchains on Mantle.
content.description: Safle is a holistic Web3 identity and account management infrastructure that enables interoperable identity across multiple blockchain networks. The protocol manages on-chain and off-chain user identity, account abstraction, and social recovery through a community-governed framework. Safle Vault provides users with a smart account that can recover access through trusted parties without seed phrases, while Safle ID creates a universal on-chain identity usable across all supported chains including Mantle.
